value: Inside the Guardian’s Library, Wravien struggles to remember his commission and sends the seeker to Gradav. Gradav also cannot leave his own work, then points toward Kamsis. The three exchanges make the library’s abundance part of the obstacle: each agent offers a fragment of direction, while none can simply lead the search to its end. Their quest dialogue records confusion and fixation; it does not fully explain what the tower has done to them.
